content: The Open Data Kit (ODK) zip file contains three Excel sheets formatted for use with ODK. These files are as follows: 1. ODK_Questionnaire_Screening_Interview: This file includes both the screening and interview programs combined. It is recommended to use this file if the screening and interview processes will be conducted on a single tablet, in the same location, or by the same staff member. 2. ODK_Questionnaire_Screening: This file contains only the screening program. It is suitable for scenarios where a participant will be screened in one location or by one person and then transferred to another location or staff member for the interview process. If you use this file, you must also use the file named ODK_Questionnaire_Survey. 3. ODK_Questionnaire_Survey: This file contains only the interview program. It is intended for use when a participant is screened in one location or by one person and then moved to another location or staff member for the interview process. If you use this file, you must also use the file named ODK_Questionnaire_Screening. Instructions for Setting Up ODK Collect on a Tablet: 1. Download the ODK Collect application from the Google Play Store onto the tablet. 2. Open the ODK Collect application. The main menu will display options such as Fill Blank Form, Edit Saved Form, and Send Finalized Form, among others. Click on the three vertical dots in the top-right corner and select General Settings. 3. Under Server Settings, choose Configure Platform Settings. 4. In the URL field, input the web address of your data server, appending your account username after the last backslash. 5. In the Username field, enter your account username. 6. In the Password field, input the password associated with your account. 7. Click the back button to return to the main menu, then select Get Blank Form. 8. You will see a list of all forms uploaded to your server account. Select the forms you wish to download onto the tablet. The download process may take a few seconds to several minutes, depending on the internet connection speed and file size. Once the forms are downloaded, you will receive a notification. 9. After downloading the forms, you can turn off the Wi-Fi. Return to the main menu and select Fill Blank Form to access the forms. After completing a form, you can save it locally on the tablet. To send the completed form to the server, you will need to reconnect to Wi-Fi. Troubleshooting: If the forms do not download successfully, verify that all the settings mentioned above have been entered correctly. If the settings are correct, turn off the Wi-Fi connection, wait a few seconds, and then turn it back on. If the issue persists, restart the tablet by turning it off and on again.
